info.title: vionvi CRM Universal API
info.description: vionvi CRM is a tenant-scoped CRM API for managing clients, leads, contracts, tasks, organizations, funnels, sources, payments, realty objects, catalogs, users, and related operational records.

get.description: Retrieves the client count from vionvi CRM.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Total client count returned by the API.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
